title: bhf.extension.v1 response
description: A response envelope an out-of-process extension returns for one request. Transported as a length-framed message: {u32 little-endian length}{UTF-8 JSON payload}. The result class is deterministic: ok/reject/finding are target-truth outcomes; unsupported and infrastructure_error are bounded extension-side failures that must never be reported as a target vulnerability. An unknown top-level field is rejected (additionalProperties: false), so a forged or extended response is a bounded protocol error rather than being silently accepted.

value.description: Capability-specific output for a non-oracle `ok` response (codec.*, mutator.mutate, scenario.*, lifecycle.*). Examples: {"output_b64": <base64>} for codec.encode/repair and mutator.mutate; {"decoded": <structured>} for codec.decode; {"done": true} or {"message_b64": <base64>, "label": <string>} for scenario.next. oracle.evaluate leaves it unset (its result travels in `finding`).

detail.description: An optional human-readable reason for a reject/unsupported/infrastructure_error.

signature_inputs.description: Ordered inputs to the finding signature; the host hashes these in the order given so the signature reproduces byte-for-byte on replay/minimize.

min_predicate.description: An optional minimization-predicate identifier the extension exposes.
